abstract.t: This specification defines the OAuth Authorization Grant Catalog: an authenticated, relationship-specific description of the authorization grants that a Resource Authorization Server is prepared to accept from a Grant Issuer. A Grant Issuer is an authorization server, such as an identity provider, that issues grants for redemption at the Resource Authorization Server. For each eligible target tenant, a catalog describes the protected resources, scope values, authorization details types, claims, subject identifier formats, and grant binding methods that the Resource Authorization Server accepts. The Grant Issuer uses the catalog as input to the policy under which it issues grants; the catalog is not an authorization decision. The data model is independent of grant encoding and retrieval protocol. This specification applies it only to the Identity Assertion JWT Authorization Grant (ID-JAG), and defines an OAuth retrieval protocol that delivers the complete catalog in one response.
